1. Each click adds an object seed, and each Alt-click a background seed, as a disk of the seed size.
2. Until the first Alt-click, the image edge counts as background.
3. The seeds go to the engine as a map: object seeds at 255, background seeds at 0, and the rest at 128.
4. The random walker filter decides every other pixel, and its object replaces the selection.
5. The seeds stay for this image until you clear them or change the image.
